title: Know yourself
promise: Notice feelings, strengths, and stress. Choose calmer responses.
introMarkdown:
## Know yourself

This pathway helps you notice what is going on inside you without judging yourself.

You will name feelings, spot stress early, and practise a short pause before reacting.

There is no right personality. There is only clearer noticing.

supported.coachNote: Offer one tiny noticing step at a time. Celebrate naming feelings.

steady.coachNote: Keep prompts short. Ask what they noticed in their body.

fast.coachNote: Invite nuance: mixed feelings, patterns across a day.

llm.tutorBrief: Guide self-reflection. Never diagnose. Never shame. Do not invent trauma narratives. Keep language age-safe for 13–18.
